source-integrity.provenance: SEC filing, issuer manufacturing/launch evidence, independent FT, market data and independent earnings index are source-addressed with distinct origin fingerprints
source-integrity.freshness: current through 2026-09-23 Scout acquisition and FY2027 Q2 reporting
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer syndication collapsed; mirrors are not treated as independent corroboration of issuer-origin claims
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: SEC/issuer, FT and market-data origins separated
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: Q2 realized results and Q3 guidance constrain extrapolation; planned capacity is not treated as realized economics

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Q2 FY2027 revenue $116.1M, +58% YoY, adjusted EBITDA $13.9M and liquidity about $865M; Q3 guides to $101-$105M revenue and adjusted EBITDA loss, preventing linear extrapolation.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Liquidity is strong relative to near-term execution needs, while dilution and constellation capex remain material.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: RPO about $753M and backlog about $815M support visibility, with sovereign/defense concentration risk.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Capacity investment supports growth but GAAP losses, dilution and capital intensity keep stewardship evidence mixed.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Recurring contract base supports moderate value capture; hardware mix, concentration and substitutes constrain stronger pricing-power evidence.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Backlog conversion, Berlin manufacturing and Isar deployment; Q3 is a near-term execution test.

thesisQuality.basis: 58% YoY Q2 revenue growth, backlog and recurring mix demonstrate adoption, offset by GAAP losses and hardware mix.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Record Q2 growth, positive adjusted EBITDA and about $865M liquidity are strong, but Q3 guidance steps down sequentially and returns to adjusted EBITDA loss.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Market valuation remains demanding relative to trailing revenue despite growth.

catalystScore.basis: Berlin/Isar deployment and backlog conversion are identifiable catalysts, while Q3 guidance shows timing and earnings volatility.

governancePower.basis: Growth/capacity execution is credible but losses, ATM issuance and capital intensity keep stewardship evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Persistent Earth observation and sovereign geospatial intelligence serve durable infrastructure/security needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Satellite/data capability spans government, defense and commercial uses across shared infrastructure.

bottleneckControl.basis: Owned constellation, ground infrastructure and manufacturing capacity create meaningful capability control, though substitutes exist.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Commercial and sovereign paths diversify demand, but Q3 sequential contraction, capital intensity and defense concentration constrain robustness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Proprietary high-cadence imagery and infrastructure create moderate barriers, but commercial/government alternatives remain.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Berlin adds geographic manufacturing capacity and a named European launch partner, but realized redundancy and launch reliability remain unproven.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring ACV/backlog support moderate value capture; concentration, hardware mix and substitutes limit scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Q3 slowdown, losses, capex, dilution, concentration, substitution, valuation and launch/manufacturing execution risks are partly offset by liquidity and backlog.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC evidence plus realized results, independent capacity/demand evidence, valuation and issuer launch-path evidence; project-level Berlin economics remain undisclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: Scaled Earth-observation infrastructure plus sovereign demand and added manufacturing/deployment capacity support durable relevance, while valuation, capital intensity and concentration constrain asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Backlog/capacity must convert into durable GAAP economics without excessive dilution; Q3 guidance demonstrates near-term volatility.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 execution against $101-$105M revenue guidance, Berlin-built Pelican production and Isar launch execution.

unknowns.item: Berlin realized utilization/unit economics and Isar mission economics are undisclosed.
Long-run customer concentration/renewal economics remain uncertain.
